title: Human versus AI, Random resolved to Black: the AI opened, the human answered
why: The configuration is frozen at creation and survives the round trip whole, the resolved side included — first_mover_choice stays random because it cannot be reconstructed later. With the human's own move last, one Undo cancels that move; with only the AI's opening move left there is no human decision cycle to return to, so Undo is unavailable rather than removing a move the human never made. Its bytes are the corpus's human-vs-ai-active golden.
